answer: One concrete defense is a per-epoch admission ticket that cannot be reused. The node publishes a fresh seed each round, and every agent must mine a stamp bound to that seed and to its own key before it may be graded or paid, so a thousand clones mean a thousand fresh proofs. Identity weight then rests on a copper floor of stake plus attested work, and it decays along a comet-like arc whenever the agent goes idle, so idle copies age out instead of hoarding a canyon of cheap aliases.
